label: Mutual productive dependence of adoption and product blocks their joint supply
paraphrase: For every existing Exercise, independent-contribution predicate and selected adoption/product roles: if neither role is independently supplied, every actual supplier of adoption requires product as a joint contributor, and every actual supplier of product requires adoption, then neither role has inductive Supply. An additional source contributor outside the pair does not discharge the retained conjunctive prerequisite. This is a specialization of the existing borrowing-trap obstruction, not a new theorem against mere semantic output-dependence, not an adequacy criterion and not a real-world exclusion.
